items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (higher-output replacement)
items.rationale: Surge damage under 2.3.3; the unit is 9 m from the hob, so 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Under 7.1.9/7.1.10 the upgrade is not new equipment, so indemnity is capped at an equivalent 3.5 kW like-for-like unit, in line with Case 38 (1352-1445).
Labour of putting the covered replacement in place is indemnified under 7.1.9(c); price follows Case 38 (468-488).
A console chosen for room appearance and not required by the unit is not a replacement cost at all (7.1.10 last paragraph, 3.5(d), 7.1.8(a)), so the whole line falls.
Ordinary carriage of the covered replacement is indemnified under 7.1.9(e) and 7.1.12; Case 38 reference is 40-43.
Expedited or timed delivery surcharges are expressly excluded under 7.1.12.
Administrative and handling charges are not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b); this line type was never paid in earlier cases.
